context: Riku and Aoi reminisce about childhood anime.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (小学校/出演/アニメ/バカ/嫌い) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 小学校の頃、アニメが大好きだったよ。
lines.en: In elementary school, I loved anime.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私も!好きな声優、出演してた?
lines.en: Me too! Did your favorite voice actor appear?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、今も色々なアニメに出演してるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, they still appear in lots of anime.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 小学校で、よく真似したなー。
lines.en: I used to imitate it in elementary school.
lines.style: giggly barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バカみたいに、何度も見たんだ。
lines.en: I watched it over and over like a fool.
lines.style: playful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私は、怖いシーンが嫌いだったよ。
lines.style: sheepish barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バカにしないでよ、僕も怖かったし。
lines.en: Don't tease me, I was scared too.
lines.style: laughing teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 小学校の思い出、最高だね!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
